what: PNC Financial Services is one of the largest regional banks in the United States, headquartered in Pittsburgh with branches coast to coast. It does retail banking, corporate and institutional banking, and asset management.
customers: Households and small businesses in its branch markets, corporations, government entities and wealth clients.
money: deposits, mortgages, cards and consumer lending
commercial lending, real estate finance and treasury management
moat: A national commercial banking franchise built on deposit relationships and treasury services that companies rarely move.
risks: Commercial property loans, especially offices, are a sector-wide concern
Deposit costs rise with competition for savings
Regional banks face higher capital and liquidity requirements
Loan growth is slow when businesses hold back on investment
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year with a 28% net margin
Expanding into new metropolitan markets with a branch-light model
A dividend yield above 3.5% with a strong capital position
watch: Net interest income guidance and office property loan reserves.
